test_scope: Only new diagnostic helpers, fixed literal synthetic payloads, AST/static source inspection, and finite subprocess fault stubs. No import of historical source, actual candidate/reference evaluate, five measurement fixtures, data files, generated/fuzzed scientific payloads, real observations, or broad policy/game suites.
execution_policy: Write all supplemental finite manifests before invoking tests. Reruns may repeat only these cases to validate repairs; report exact command, count and result for each run. New cases require prospective manifest amendment before running and remain stub-only.
